scope: read-only inert operator runner review; no imports, runtime, authority mutation or model calls

findings.detail: Caller can change operation_id to reserve the same one-turn request again. Bind deterministic operation identity to request content before existing reserve.
Router.close return alone cannot establish owned worker cleanup: adapter.close ignores cleanup bool. Retain actual cleanup result using existing owned handle.
Only success outcome assigns receipt and links host evidence. Failure/cancellation needs safe canonical scoped attempt/receipt evidence retained with unknown accounting distinguished.
Bind source_root to actual imported package/runtime dependencies rather than only hashing a caller-supplied path.

limits: No manufactured full conformance from scripted callbacks
No fresh request/model execution before reset and confirmed capacity
Reviewed request is separately finite and may not be widened or retried

resolved_findings.resolution: Deterministic composed:<request.plan_id> identity rejected on reuse by existing reserve.
Exact owned container absence and exited transport/no callback tasks checked under shared cleanup deadline.
Scoped exact-action attempt/receipt/journal snapshots retained before owned store closes, including failures.
Caller source_root must match loaded aeep package root and frozen digest.
Positive BoundaryProbe publication delayed until actual cleanup and finish_operation succeed.

Actual registered factory pinned before clone; actual adapter dynamic factory pinned before startup/per-dispatch. Bounded ordinary function/bound-method closure/default/keyword producer traversal; opaque callable classes rejected.

limitations: No actual worker/native/model launch by reviewer or this prepared runner.
Offline tests use synthetic repository/transport plumbing; they do not establish actual conformance or qualification.
Fresh reviewed exact request, worker/profile/scope/source dependencies and confirmed capacity after reset remain required.
One READ callback observation does not complete the fifteen-probe composed conformance gate.
Function file pins do not constitute transitive arbitrary Python behavior proof; use a fresh process and exact reviewed operator composition/import path.
